method_notes: Latency samples are OS-cache-warm and process/allocator-warm within each ignored release test.
RSS samples run each arm in a fresh direct release-test child and use macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size bytes plus a steady ps sample.
Fixture generation and materialization occur outside timed admission samples.

A0 and A1 host samples start from the same filesystem source and report the same physical source bytes read; every A0 parser, nesting, record, AST, reference, and dependency counter aggregates its admission plus ordinary-load decode.
Matrix source SHA-256 values are framed hashes of the exact 18-file canonical source tree.

A0/A1/C/D/F timing and RSS rows were regenerated at 4ed7f994 after the cancellation and dependency-edge accounting corrections; E1 was regenerated at 6644115 after source-derived fact validation and pinned-snapshot race closure; final counterbalanced B and immutable-Git-object E2 rows were regenerated at be4d801; A0 aggregate logical-decode counters and full-oracle verification were corrected at 607e920.
The earlier 1b3d75de and bd115c8 captures plus concurrently launched or interrupted exploratory E2 runs were discarded; no superseded row is present in the committed CSV files.
The sidecar is a JSON envelope, not SQLite; sidecar_bytes is the complete serialized JSON byte length and there are no WAL/SHM files.

Validated E1/E2 reuse pins all 18 source files, independently re-derives the complete Structural Index, and compares every sidecar fact before reuse. E2 reads the exact Git blob object IDs bound by object format, commit, tree, path, and mode; it does not derive trusted facts from the mutable worktree. Identity-plus-decode is retained only as a non-authoritative decomposition metric.
B alternates baseline_then_background and background_then_baseline order and records arm_order in every raw row; the counterbalanced p95 ratio fails the 10 percent foreground-regression gate.
No failed or cancelled measurement row was silently removed. Cancellation outcomes are explicit in progressive-background-raw.csv.

row_context.fixture_join: Derive experiment from fixture_experiment_by_artifact, then join each raw row to fixture-manifest.csv by experiment/workload/entities/source_sha256; where a raw source_sha256 is absent, use the matching literal unknown fixture row.
row_context.explicit_outcome_exception: progressive-background-raw.csv records cancellation_outcome=cancelled for every cancellation-pressure row.
row_context.oracle_status: A0/A1 complete Documents are exactly equal under success, cold numeric mutation, SCC, and evaluation-failure pressure; those same shapes independently preserve calculate_complete outcomes and workspace validation stable observations. C/D never claim SemanticCurrent and return requires_full_admission for unsupported formula/validation proof.
row_context.phase_boundary: HostReady is the already-running release test process and is excluded; no shell/UI milestone is measured. SourceKnown, first source preview, SemanticCurrent, bounded-result, scan, sidecar, cancellation, and RSS fields are explicit where applicable.
row_context.unknown_metadata: Unknown values are the literal unknown in fixture-manifest.csv; no unavailable per-row metadata is inferred.
